newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metsa-Serla suspended in Helsinki - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Metsa-Serla suspended in Helsinki - bourse.

text.p: Trade in shares of Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy were suspended on Tuesday on the Helsinki Stock Exchange at the company's own request, the bourse said in a statement.
Before the suspension, Metsa-Serla B traded 2.00 markka higher at 36.00 markka. Early volume was a moderately lively 58,000 shares.
The share's year-high price is 37.00 markka and the year-low 24.60 markka.
Metsa-Serla will hold a joint news conference with another Finnish forest industry group, UPM-Kymmene Oy, at 1200 (1000 GMT).
